paper: Any-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection by Spectral Learning (Karageorgiou, Papadopoulos, Kompatsiaris, Gavves — CVPR 2025)
training_set_in_paper: Self-supervised masked-spectral-learning on REAL images only, then a detector head trained on a single latent-diffusion (LDM) generator vs real. ~180k LDM-generated (256x256, Corvi et al. DMimageDetection 'latent_diffusion_trainingset') + 180k reals (COCO + LSUN); val = 20k+20k. Backbone = MFM-pretrained ViT-B/16 (mfm_pretrain_vit_base.pth). See README Training; configs/spai.yaml TRAIN.EPOCHS 35.

benchmarks.name: SPAI main eval set (13 generators x 5 real sources) — the paper's headline
subsets_or_generators: 13 generators (data/ CSVs): SD-1.3, SD-1.4, SD-2, SD-3, SDXL, Glide, DALLE2, DALLE3, Firefly, Flux, GigaGAN, MidJourney-v5, MidJourney-v6.1. Synthbuster supplies the Glide/SD1.3/SD1.4/SD2/SDXL/DALLE2/DALLE3/Firefly/MidJourney fakes; SD3/MJv6.1/GigaGAN/Flux supplied via authors' GDrive.

paper_number.note: Table 1 headline = ~91.0% mean AUC across 13 generators x 5 real sources; +5.5% absolute AUC over prior SOTA (RINE 85.5). Metric is AUC, not AP/acc.

paper_per_generator.note: Per-generator AUC in Table 1; generators bucketed by resolution: <0.5MP {Glide,SD1.3,SD1.4}, 0.5-1MP {Flux,DALLE2,SD2,SDXL,SD3}, >1MP {GigaGAN,MJv5,MJv6.1,DALLE3,Firefly}. Exact per-cell AUCs in paper Table 1 (not transcribed here to avoid invented digits).

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: ANY-/NATIVE-RESOLUTION. configs/spai.yaml: RESOLUTION_MODE='arbitrary', TEST.ORIGINAL_RESOLUTION=True, MINIMUM_PATCHES=4, REQUIRED_NORMALIZATION='positive_0_1' (no ImageNet norm at dataset side), FEATURE_EXTRACTION_BATCH=400. Each test image is processed at its NATIVE resolution: spai/models/sid.py PatchBasedMFViT.forward_arbitrary_resolution_batch (sid.py:176-237) patchifies the full image into overlapping 224x224 patches (patchify_image, stride=PATCH_STRIDE), runs every patch through the MFM ViT, and aggregates with Spectral Context Attention (patches_attention). If an image yields < MINIMUM_PATCHES(4) patches it falls back to five_crop (sid.py:198-202). NO global resize to a fixed size. Metric = torchmetrics AUROC (spai/metrics.py:56,88-96). Run: `python -m spai test --cfg configs/spai.yaml --opt MODEL.PATCH_VIT.MINIMUM_PATCHES 4 --test-csv <csv>` with --model <epoch>.pth.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Eval set not on disk: Synthbuster plus the SD3 / MJv6.1 / GigaGAN / Flux fakes (authors' GDrive) and the RAISE / FODB / OpenImages / ImageNet / COCO test reals are not staged. The served path follows the protocol (native-resolution any-res PatchBasedMFViT wrapper with Spectral Context Attention), but SynthScope reports mAP/acc, not the paper's AUC.
benchmarks.dataset_source: gated/external. Synthbuster: Zenodo https://zenodo.org/records/10066460 (record 10066460). SD3/MJv6.1/GigaGAN/Flux: authors' GDrive https://drive.google.com/file/d/1no5T89h97TZvAKNCHKt2PQfKZ1UDtbI4/view . Real sources: RAISE-1k (loki.disi.unitn.it/RAISE), FODB (faui1-files.cs.fau.de/.../fodb), Open Images V7, COCO2017 test, ImageNet test (Kaggle ILSVRC). docs/data.md lists all; data/*.csv enumerate the exact files.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (cross-dataset, SynthScope benchmark)

paper_number.note: GenImage is NOT a primary SPAI paper table; it is the SynthScope cross-reference benchmark. The paper's headline is its own 13-gen/5-real AUC set, not GenImage.
